title: How Many Bishops to BEAT Martin?
summary: King plus bishops (no pawns) vs Martin (250), the third of his piece-series after 1 queen and 2 rooks. Starting with two bishops on the long diagonals to 'anticipate blunders', adding one per loss. Martin closes the centre with pawn chains; it took three bishops, ending with a K+B mating net.
rules: Player (White): king + N bishops; Martin: full army.
Start N=2 (one alone 'exceedingly unlikely'), add one bishop each loss.
